# kkp_kubernetes_versions (Data Source)

Kubernetes versions KKP offers for new clusters of a provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kkp_kubernetes_versions" "openstack" {
  cloud_provider = "openstack"
}

output "versions" {
  value = data.kkp_kubernetes_versions.openstack.versions
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cloud_provider` (String) Cloud provider; defaults to `openstack`.

### Read-Only

- `default_version` (String) The version KKP preselects.
- `latest_version` (String)
- `versions` (List of String) Oldest first.
